name: GrainCorp Limited
summary: GrainCorp Limited operates as an agribusiness and processing company in Australasia, North America, Europe, Asia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Ukraine, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Agribusiness and Nutrition and Energy. The company engages in the operation of an integrated grain storage and handling network comprising receival sites and bulk port terminals; purchasing, storing, transporting, and selling agricultural commodities; handling wheat, barley, sorghum, corn, canola, and chickpeas; and trading, importing and exporting cereals, oilseeds, and pulses.
